description: Read this API key's session audit events in sequence order, including after the session closes. Returns events and next_cursor; pass next_cursor as cursor to read the next page. Reading the audit is free and does not require agent control of the browser.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from an earlier page for this session.

session_id.description: Browser session ID. Defaults to this connection's active session.

name: get_session_audit
title: Read session audit
